help.title: Frequently Asked Questions & Portal Guide
help.subtitle: Patentability criteria, Section 3(p) exclusions, State Biodiversity Board approvals aur expert escalation ke baare mein answers paayein.
help.searchPlaceholder: FAQ questions ya legal concepts search karein...
help.q1: IP-SAKTI Sahayak kya hai aur ye Ayurveda innovators ki kaise madad karta hai?
help.a1: IP-SAKTI Sahayak ek public service portal hai jo Vaidyas, researchers, startups aur manufacturers ko Intellectual Property (Patents, Trademarks, GI), Traditional Knowledge (TKDL) aur Biodiversity (ABS) regulations samajhne mein madad karta hai.
help.q2: Kya classical Ayurvedic formulations (e.g., Chyawanprash, Sitopaladi Churna) ka patent ho sakta hai?
help.a2: Nahi. Indian Patents Act 1970 ke Section 3(p) ke tahat public domain mein uplabdh classical formulations patent nahi ho sakte. Lekin novel standardized extraction methods ya Section 3(e) synergistic compositions par patent consider ho sakta hai.
help.q3: Kya manufacturing ya patent se pehle NBA approval zaroori hai?
help.a3: Haan. Biological Diversity Act 2002 ke tahat Indian biological resources use karne par SBB ko intimation aur patent apply karne se pehle NBA se Form III approval mandatory hai.
help.q4: Confidence levels (High, Moderate, Preliminary) ka kya matlab hai?
help.a4: Confidence score aapke query ke facts aur Indian statutes/TKDL ke statutory alignment ko darshata hai. Incomplete facts par system safe abstention follow karta hai.
help.q5: Human Expert Review kaise kaam karta hai?
help.a5: Complex multi-domain cases mein aap expert review request kar sakte hain. Aapka dossier empanelled IP attorney ya TKDL specialist ko route hota hai jo dashboard mein signed guidance dete hain.
help.q6: Kya mera data aur formula private aur secure hai?
help.a6: Haan. IP-SAKTI Sahayak Data Minimization principles follow karta hai. Examiner notes protected hain aur data fully secure rehta hai.
help.contactSupportDesc: Procedural guidance ke liye facilitation team se connect karein.
